description:
Polyglot Data Modeling for SQL and NoSQL databases, APIs, and storage formats

Hackolade Studio is an intuitive yet powerful application to perform the visually data modeling and schema design of many SQL and NoSQL databases, APIS, and storage formats.
Hackolade Studio combines the graphical representation of collections in an Entity Relationship Diagram, with the graphical representation of the JSON Schema definition of each collection in a hierarchical schema view. Together, these graphical representations provide the schema model for data-at-rest and data-in-motion, plus the documentation of that model. The application is specifically designed around the powerful nature of JSON nested sub-objects and denormalization.
The software facilitates the work of, and the dialog between analysts, architects, designers, developers, testers, DBAs, and operators of systems that are based on such technologies. It also can generate schema scripts and documentation in a variety of machine-readable formats (DDLs, JSON Schema, Avro, Parquet, Protobuf, ...) as well as database instances, or human-readable formats such as HTML, Markdown, and PDF reports.
Instead of having to find data structures tacitly described in the application code, the creation of a database model helps to evaluate design options beforehand, think through the implications of different alternatives, and recognize potential hurdles before committing sizable amounts of development effort. A database model helps plan ahead, in order to minimize later rework. In the end, the modeling process accelerates development, increases quality of the application, and reduces execution risks.
- Tech refresh: ElectronJS v45.4.1 (Chromium v156.0.8078.100, NodeJS v24.22.3, V8 v15.6.75.57), and related modules
- Command-Line Interface: added support for forward- and reverse-engineering of .xdbml files
- ERD: enhanced display of alternate key numbers and positions for referenced attributes
- MEGA: enhanced import logic to either keep container color from file or assign different color for each
- PowerDesigner: added support for views defined inside packages
- PowerDesigner: added support for data items, domains, inheritances, and associations defined inside packages
- Avro: resolved HTML documentation generation for inactive records with target script enabled
- BigQuery: added support for tags on datasets, tables and views, and data governance tags on columns
- BigQuery, CockroachDB, Db2, Db2 for z/OS, DeltaLake/Databricks, Glue, Hive, MariaDB, Oracle, SQLServer/Azure SQL, Teradata: adjusted DDL script generation to handle deactivated objects in separate statements
- DeltaLake/Databricks: avoided duplicate view statement when column comments are generated in separate statements
- MongoDB: removed the index Hashed property which generated an invalid "hashed: true" option in createIndex statements
- PostgreSQL: added support for index comments in forward-engineering and reverse-engineering
- PostgreSQL: ensured valid ALTER INDEX statements in alter scripts for quoted index names, and no rename when an index name is cleared
- Redshift: added support for column collation in forward- and reverse-engineering
- Redshift: routed cluster and workgroup lookup through proxy configured in Studio during reverse-engineering
- Snowflake: maintained tag references with naming conventions and source attributes as technical names when reverse-engineering DDL
- SQLServer/AzureSQL, Synapse: enhanced reverse-engineering of tables with large binary columns
